# omniddi_ipam_containers (Data Source)

Lists IPAM containers. The tree is walked from `parent_id` (or from the address-family roots when it is not set); each level is one API call, so scope the walk with `parent_id` on large trees.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "omniddi_ipam_containers" "all" {}

data "omniddi_ipam_containers" "top_level" {
  recursive = false
}

data "omniddi_ipam_containers" "below_corp" {
  parent_id = 42
  search    = "datacenter"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `parent_id` (Number) Only list containers below this node.
- `recursive` (Boolean) Also descend into containers found. Defaults to `true`.
- `search` (String) Case-insensitive substring matched against the name, CIDR, owner and description.
- `tag_filters` (Map of String) Only list containers carrying all of these tag values (own or inherited).

### Read-Only

- `containers` (Attributes List) The matching containers, ordered by id. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--containers))

<a id="nestedatt--containers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `containers`

Read-Only:

- `business_unit_id` (Number) Business unit the node belongs to (own or inherited).
- `cidr` (String) The network in CIDR notation, such as `10.0.0.0/24`.
- `created_on` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `description` (String) Free-text description.
- `has_children` (Boolean) Whether the node has child networks.
- `id` (Number) The node id. For a subnet this equals the `networks.id` used by DHCP resources.
- `name` (String) Node label. Defaults to the CIDR when no name was given.
- `owner` (String) Owner label.
- `parent_id` (Number) Id of the parent node.
- `prefix_length` (Number) Prefix length of the network.
- `protocol` (String) `IPv4` or `IPv6`.
- `status` (String) `ACTIVE`, `INACTIVE` or `DEPRECATED`.
- `tags` (Map of String) Single-valued tags on the node (inherited values excluded when reported as inherited).
- `tags_list` (Map of List of String) Multi-valued tags on the node.
- `type` (String) Node type: `ROOT`, `FAMILY`, `CONTAINER` or `SUBNET`.
- `updated_on` (String) Last update timestamp.
- `vlan` (String) VLAN label.
